provenance.ballPolicy: Leo has no carried-ball track in this defensive block. The separate basketball remains controlled by the shooter and the simulation handles contact/block response; no ball is painted into Leo’s poses.

review.reviewNotes: Four complete right-facing poses show a defensive set, two-arm takeoff, one-hand apex block at tick5 and controlled landing. Leo remains pale, adult and human with long wavy black hair, refined mustache and black/crimson uniform. No ball is drawn.
